title: Video Use: open-source Claude Code agent video editor (browser-use)
summary: Spanish-language post highlights Video Use, an open-source browser-use project that auto-edits raw footage in a folder—cutting clips, removing filler words, adding captions, color grading, and rendering without a manual timeline.
question_it_answers: What open-source tool lets Claude Code auto-edit raw video folders without a timeline?

claims.text: Video Use handles cutting, filler removal, captions, color correction, animations, and final render from a folder of raw files.
claims.subject: ai-video-generation

claims.text: video-use README (2026-09-04) still describes a local-folder editor: clone/symlink + ffmpeg, drop takes in a directory, write edit/final.mp4. Browser Use Cloud is optional, not required.
claims.evidence: Drop raw footage in a folder… All outputs live in <videos_dir>/edit/. Cloud link is optional.
claims.subject: ai-video-generation

claims.text: Local video-use helpers/render.py on a 2-range lavfi EDL wrote draft final.mp4 132,217 B / 1.666 s / 1280x720 / 24 fps libx264. No Claude Code session and no ElevenLabs key.
claims.evidence: testsrc+sine 2.000s 35910 B in; two 0.80s ranges; --draft --no-subtitles --no-loudnorm exit 0. analysis/_work/captures/video-use-edit/.
claims.subject: ai-video-generation
